title: iTestAgent Configuration
description: Published JSON Schema for the iTestAgent configuration file (itestagent.jsonc). Runtime source of truth: ItestAgentConfigSchema in packages/itestagent-contracts/src/config.ts (US-18.1, US-18.2; AGENTS.md §5 data contracts; ADR-011 device targetKind model). Parity is enforced by packages/itestagent-contracts/test/json-schema-parity.test.ts.

schemaVersion.description: Config schema version (AGENTS.md §5 data contracts: artifacts carry schemaVersion).

model.description: Model config (US-18.1 AC2: local dependencies plus an OpenAI-compatible model API key). apiKeyRef stores only a Keychain key or environment variable name; plaintext API keys are never persisted (R6 / US-18.2 AC3).

apiKeyRef.description: API key reference name (Keychain key or environment variable name); never the plaintext key (R6 / US-18.2 AC3).

device.description: Device config (ADR-011: first-class physical and Simulator support; backend selection configured independently per targetKind with same-type fallback).

preferredBackends.description: Per-targetKind preferred backend list (highest priority first).

allowCrossTargetFallback.description: Whether cross-targetKind fallback is allowed (default false; requires user confirmation per ADR-011).

tui.description: TUI config (tech selection §5: OpenTUI+SolidJS target mainline, Ink verified fallback).
